blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear, well-defined text with sharp edges and excellent focus quality.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as text clarity is excellent for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt exhibits excellent black text on white background contrast with uniform lighting.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: Maintain this high contrast standard for future document captures.

glare_identification.description: No glare, bright spots or reflections are visible on the receipt surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: Continue using current lighting conditions for document captures.

water_stains.description: The receipt shows no signs of water damage, discoloration or staining.
water_stains.recommendation: No action needed as document is free from water damage.

tears_or_folds.description: Minor creases are visible on the receipt but do not impact text legibility.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Consider flattening receipts before scanning, though current state is acceptable for OCR.

cut_off_detection.description: The entire receipt is captured within the frame with all text visible and complete.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Maintain current framing technique for document captures.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with all standard sections visible including header, line items, totals, and footer information.
missing_sections.recommendation: Continue capturing full receipts as demonstrated in this example.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows or other obstructions are present on the receipt surface.
obstructions.recommendation: Maintain current capture technique with clean, unobstructed document presentation.
